default: sell automations to businesses on a retainer (AAA model)
flip: rev-share / outcome-only - charge nothing upfront, take a cut of value recovered (kills the reachability barrier)
recombine: operator-owned proof - run/co-own one automated regulated business as the case study + data moat
contrarian_bet: outcome-only pricing + operator-owned proof (attacks reachability + trust from the side)
